# Pothole Requests Forecasts

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(readr)
library(tidyverse) 
library(fpp3)  
library(patchwork)
dir.create('figures', showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Data Inspection

```{r}
pothole <- read_csv('Data/get_it_done_pothole_requests_datasd.csv')
head(pothole)
```

```{r}
dim(pothole)
```

```{r}
pothole |> 
  select(date_requested, date_closed, zipcode, council_district, sap_notification_number, case_age_days, status, date_closed) |>
  glimpse()
```

```{r}
pothole |> summarise(
  # first observation
  first_observation = min(date_requested),
  # last observation
  last_observation = max(date_requested),
  missing_dates = sum(is.na(date_requested))
)
```

### Filter to Unique Requests

```{r}
# duplicate requests store the id of the original "parent" request in 'service_request_parent_id' 
# is.na checks for distinct potholes requests that returns true if NA in 'service_request_parent_id' 
pothole_unique <- pothole |> 
  mutate(is_unique = is.na(service_request_parent_id))

# orignal vs duplicates 
pothole_unique |> 
  count(is_unique) |> 
  mutate(share = n/sum(n))
```

69% of pothole service requests are unique

```{r}
# monthly potholes (unique)
pothole_monthly <- pothole_unique |> 
  # data to month 
  mutate(month = yearmonth(date_requested)) |> 
  # complete months only
  filter(month >= yearmonth('2016 Jun'),
         month <= yearmonth('2026 Oct')) |>
  group_by(month) |> 
  summarise(
    requests_unique = sum(is_unique), # distinct requests
    total_reports = n(),              # all requests including duplicates
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) |> 
  as_tsibble(index = month)
pothole_monthly
```

```{r}
pothole_daily <- pothole_unique |>
  mutate(day = as.Date(date_requested)) |>
  count(day, name = "requests") |>
  as_tsibble(index = day)

# any days missing
has_gaps(pothole_daily)

# gaps
pothole_daily |>
  count_gaps() |>
  arrange(desc(.n))
```

### Data Partitioning

```{r}
# training set to fit models
train_data <- pothole_monthly |> 
  filter_index(. ~ '2024 Oct')

# validation set to compare models and chose the best performing model
val_data <- pothole_monthly |> 
  filter_index('2024 Nov' ~ '2025 Oct')

# test set for final evaluation 
test_data <- pothole_monthly |> 
  filter_index('2025 Nov' ~ .)
```

```{r}
tibble(
  set = c('Train', 'Validation', 'Test'),
  first = c(min(train_data$month), min(val_data$month), min(test_data$month)),
  last = c(max(train_data$month), max(val_data$month), max(test_data$month)),
  months = c(nrow(train_data), nrow(val_data), nrow(test_data))
)
```

**Note:** We’re only using the training and validation sets, so we'll exclude the test set for now.

```{r}
pothole_monthly |> 
  autoplot(requests_unique) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date(c(yearmonth('2024 Nov'), yearmonth('2025 Nov'))),
    linetype = 'dashed', linewidth = 0.5, colour ='orange') +
  labs(
    title = 'Monthly Unique Pothole Requests',
    subtitle = 'Lines show validation and test periods',
    y = 'Number of unique requests'
  ) -> p_unique_pothole_ts

ggsave('figures/unique_pothole_requests_monthly.png', plot = p_unique_pothole_ts,
       width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
p_unique_pothole_ts
```

**TSLM Modeling**

```{r}
# Time Series Linear Model - requests_unique
req_tslm <- train_data %>%
  model(
    auto_tslm = TSLM(requests_unique),
    tr_tslm = TSLM(requests_unique ~ trend()),
    sea_tslm = TSLM(requests_unique ~ season()),
    tslm = TSLM(requests_unique ~ trend() + season())
  )

# assessing the model fits
glance(req_tslm) |>
  select(.model, r_squared, adj_r_squared, AIC, AICc, BIC) |>
  arrange(AIC) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(r_squared, adj_r_squared), ~ round(.x, 3)),
    across(c(AIC, AICc, BIC), ~ round(.x, 0))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Model",
      "R-squared",
      "Adjusted R-squared",
      "AIC",
      "AICc",
      "BIC"
    ),
    caption = "TSLM Model Comparison (ranked by AIC)"
  )

train_data %>%
  autoplot(requests_unique) +
  autolayer(
    fitted(req_tslm |> select("tslm")),
    .fitted,
    colour = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "TSLM: Monthly Pothole Requests",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Requests"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Transformations

# find lambda for a Box-Cox transformation of the training data
lambda <- train_data |>
  features(requests_unique, features = guerrero) |>
  pull(lambda_guerrero)

# plot the transformed data side-by-side with the original data
p1 <- train_data |> autoplot(requests_unique) +
  labs(title = "Original Data", y = "Requests")

p2 <- train_data |> autoplot(log(requests_unique)) +
  labs(title = "Log Transformation", y = "Log requests")

p3 <- train_data |> autoplot(box_cox(requests_unique, -0.9)) +
  labs(title = "Box-Cox Transformation", y = "Box-Cox requests")

p1 / p2 / p3

# New TSLM models

# fit TSLM models with different seasonal specifications
tslm_models <- train_data %>%
  model(
    tslm = TSLM(requests_unique ~ trend() + season()),
    bc_sea = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() + season()),
    bc_f1 = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() +
                   fourier(period = 12, K = 1)),
    bc_f2 = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() +
                   fourier(period = 12, K = 2)),
    bc_f3 = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() +
                   fourier(period = 12, K = 3)),
    bc_f4 = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() +
                   fourier(period = 12, K = 4)),
    bc_f5 = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() +
                   fourier(period = 12, K = 5))
  )

# assessing the model fits
glance(tslm_models) |>
  select(.model, r_squared, adj_r_squared, AIC, AICc, BIC) |>
  arrange(AIC) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(r_squared, adj_r_squared), ~ round(.x, 3)),
    across(c(AIC, AICc, BIC), ~ round(.x, 0))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Model",
      "R-squared",
      "Adjusted R-squared",
      "AIC",
      "AICc",
      "BIC"
    ),
    caption = "TSLM Model Comparison (ranked by AIC)"
  )

# extract fitted values and residuals for each model
fits <- tslm_models |>
  augment()

# plot the fitted values against the original training data
tslm_fits <- tslm_models |>
  augment()

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = train_data |> as_tibble(),
    aes(x = month, y = requests_unique),
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = tslm_fits |> as_tibble(),
    aes(x = month, y = .fitted, colour = .model),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual vs Fitted TSLM Models",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Unique Requests",
    colour = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# set up cross-validation method with the top three models

# Set the final eligible CV origin
cv_cutoff <- max(train_data$month) - 12

# Keep only windows with 12 months of validation data available
cv_tslm <- train_data |>
  stretch_tsibble(.init = 60, .step = 3) |>
  group_by(.id) |>
  filter(max(month) <= cv_cutoff) |>
  ungroup()

cv_tslm_models <- cv_tslm %>%
  model(
    bc_f1 = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() +
                   fourier(period = 12, K = 1)),
    bc_f2 = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() +
                   fourier(period = 12, K = 2)),
    bc_f3 = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() +
                   fourier(period = 12, K = 3))
  )

cv_fc <- cv_tslm_models |>
  forecast(h = 12)

cv_fc |>
  as_tibble() |>
  group_by(.model) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    missing = sum(is.na(.mean)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#glance(cv_tslm_models)

cv_median <- cv_tslm_models |>
  forecast(h = 12) |>
  mutate(.median = quantile(requests_unique, 0.5)) |>
  as_tibble()

cv_accuracy <- cv_median |>
  select(.model, .id, month, .median) |>
  left_join(
    train_data |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(month, requests_unique),
    by = "month"
  ) |>
  group_by(.model, .id) |>
  summarise(
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((requests_unique - .median)^2)),
    MAE = mean(abs(requests_unique - .median)),
    MAPE = mean(abs((requests_unique - .median) / requests_unique)) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cv_accuracy_summary <- cv_accuracy |>
  group_by(.model) |>
  summarise(
    mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    mean_MAE = mean(MAE),
    mean_MAPE = mean(MAPE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(mean_RMSE)

knitr::kable(
  cv_accuracy_summary,
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Rolling-Origin Cross-Validation Accuracy"
)

# Forecasting validation subset with the Box-Cox Transformed, Fourier K = 1
# TSLM model

tslm_final <- train_data |>
  model(
    bc_f1 = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() +
                   fourier(period = 12, K = 1)),
    bc_f2 = TSLM(box_cox(requests_unique, lambda) ~ trend() +
                   fourier(period = 12, K = 2))
  )

tslm_final_fc <- tslm_final |>
  forecast(h = 12)

tslm_final_fc_med <- tslm_final_fc |>
  mutate(
    median_forecast = quantile(requests_unique, 0.5)
  )

tslm_final_accuracy <- tslm_final_fc_med |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(.model, month, median_forecast) |>
  left_join(
    val_data |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(month, requests_unique),
    by = "month"
  ) |>
  group_by(.model) |>
  summarise(
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(
      (requests_unique - median_forecast)^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )),
    MAE = mean(
      abs(requests_unique - median_forecast),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    MAPE = mean(
      abs((requests_unique - median_forecast) / requests_unique),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) * 100
  )

knitr::kable(
  tslm_final_accuracy,
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Final TSLM Validation Accuracy"
)

# Plot forecasted values, fitted values, training data and validation data

# Extract fitted values
tslm_final_fits <- tslm_final |>
  select(bc_f1) |>
  augment() |>
  mutate(
    fitted_original = inv_box_cox(.fitted, lambda)
  )

# Plot
ggplot() +
  # Training data
  geom_line(
    data = train_data |> as_tibble(),
    aes(x = month, y = requests_unique, colour = "Training data"),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Fitted values
  geom_line(
    data = tslm_final_fits |> filter(.model == "bc_f1") |> as_tibble(),
    aes(x = month, y = .fitted, colour = "Fitted values"),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Validation data
  geom_line(
    data = val_data |> as_tibble(),
    aes(x = month, y = requests_unique, colour = "Validation data"),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Forecast
  geom_line(
    data = tslm_final_fc_med |> filter(.model == "bc_f1") |> as_tibble(),
    aes(x = month, y = median_forecast, colour = "Forecast"),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Training data" = "black",
      "Fitted values" = "#2C7FB8",
      "Validation data" = "#D95F02",
      "Forecast" = "#31A354"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "TSLM: Actual vs Fitted vs Forecast",
    subtitle = "Box-Cox transformation with Fourier K = 1",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Unique Requests",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
